description: History of the health of the disks under the devices of a Storage Daemon (docs/plans/OSD-GERAETE-UND-VERTEILUNG.md, D-21): odir asks `.status health` of each Storage with `Health Check Interval` and writes one row per device and check. Written only by odir (storage_health.rs).
author: Onesimus

tables.name: onesimus.medium_health
tables.description: One check of the disk under one device of a Storage Daemon: verdict (ok, warning, critical, unknown) and the SMART values behind it.

columns.name: device
columns.description: Name of the device in the Storage Daemon

columns.name: disk
columns.description: The disk under the device, e.g. sdb

columns.name: reasons
columns.description: Why not ok, separated by semicolons

columns.name: self_test
columns.description: Result of the last self test
